generation.reference_selection: Current environment default already has T>P>S; use it unchanged as the sole reference, not any existing scenario
generation.sampling: Independent uniform proposals for all 9 deltas; reject invalid full configurations. Accepted distribution is conditional, not uniformly distributed after rejection.

generation.fixed: Z, roll, pitch, scale and rack-relative bread poses; no cumulative perturbations

allocation.method: Seeded 25-per-group allocation; within-set label swaps balance standardized signed deltas, second moments (0.35) and quartile occupancy (1.5)

extracted_table_support.note: Union of actual convex top faces; no bbox/extent substitution. Authored geometry, not cooked PhysX shapes.
